messages.content: Compute the remainder when $7^{2026}$ is divided by $100$.

Powers of 7 modulo 100 cycle with period 4: $7, 49, 43, 1, 7, \dots$

Since $2026 \equiv 3 \pmod 4$, the remainder is the third element of the cycle, namely $43$.
